name: Blacked House
source:
If you like interracial, NTR, and a household setting, you'll have fun with this one. As the story and game updates progress, you'll find your household members being slowly corrupted by your bully and other men, until your own home ends turned into a brothel and porn film studio.

[From [url=https://mandystarrx.itch.io/blacked-house]Itch[/url]]
translation:
如果你喜欢跨种族、NTR和家庭场景，那么你一定会喜欢这款游戏。随着故事和游戏的更新进展，你会发现你的家庭成员慢慢地被你的恶霸和其他男人腐蚀，直到你自己的家变成了妓院和色情电影工作室。
